description: Track Zoom App Marketplace apps in their default marketplace order, filtered by category, Zoom product, keyword or specific app IDs.

appIds.description: Audit specific apps by Zoom Marketplace app ID or app URL. Cannot be combined with category, product, keyword or usage filters.
appIds.title: App IDs or URLs to Audit

category.description: Rank every app listed in this Zoom Marketplace category. Leave empty to use a Zoom product, a keyword search or app IDs instead.
category.title: Marketplace Category

includeAppDetails.description: Fetch the full Marketplace listing for each app. Adds categories, screenshots, developer contact details, support/privacy/terms links, OAuth scopes, app type and created/modified dates (one extra request per app).
includeAppDetails.title: Include App Details

maxItems.description: Maximum number of apps to return (1-5000).
maxItems.title: Max Items

product.description: Track apps that work with this Zoom product. This is the original tracker input and keeps working unchanged.
product.title: Zoom Product

searchQuery.description: Only return marketplace apps matching this keyword in Zoom's own marketplace search (for example `notetaker` or `crm`).
searchQuery.title: Keyword Search

usage.description: Only return apps installed by admins or apps any user can operate.
usage.title: User Role

title: Zoom Marketplace Category Tracker Input
